title: Define form-owner updates through DOM hooks

labels.name: topic: shadow
labels.description: Relates to shadow trees (as defined in DOM)

body:
Replace scattered form-owner mutation requirements with explicit HTML insertion, removing, moving, and attribute change steps. Define affected trees and tree-order processing, limiting ID-triggered resets to connected trees and controls whose `form` values match an affected ID. Fix missing ancestor-form fallback when form-attribute controls disconnect and missing reassociation when they move between trees. Compute the replacement form owner before changing the association, doing nothing when it is unchanged; this prevents reassociation between forms from temporarily joining the ownerless radio group and unchecking unrelated radios. (All browsers currently uncheck unrelated radios in disconnection cases, but we are intentionally changing that.) Custom-element reaction ordering, disabledness updates, and broader same-tree/parser-established association behavior during moves remain out of scope; see https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/13185. Helps with https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10331. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): - Chromium and WebKit match the disconnected ancestor-form fallback and reassociation without temporary disassociation; Gecko differs on both. - Cross-tree moves match Chromium and Gecko; WebKit does not yet implement `moveBefore()` - WebKit is interested in fixing radio disconnection per Matrix discussion, and Chromium per below comments. - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: - https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64694 - https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65068 (disconnection and cross-tree moves) - https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65101 (radio groups during form-owner resets) - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: - Chromium: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/585296922 - Gecko: - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2091908 (disconnection) - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2092113 (radio reassociation) - WebKit: - https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=331415 (radio owner on disconnection) - https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=281223 (`moveBefore()` implementation) - Deno (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, module resolution, web workers, and web storage): N/A - Node.js (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, and module resolution): N/A - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use. (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** ### :boom: Error: Wattsi server error :boom: ### [PR Preview](https://github.com/specinfra/pr-preview#pr-preview) failed to build. _(Last tried on Nov 13, 2026, 1:48 PM UTC)_.
More PR Preview relies on a number of web services to run. There seems to be an issue with the following one: :rotating_light: [Wattsi Server](https://github.com/domenic/wattsi-server) - Wattsi Server is the web service used to build the WHATWG HTML spec. :link: [Related URL](https://build.whatwg.org/wattsi) **Error output:** ```

Error code: 503

Well, This is unexpected. An Error has occurred, and we are working to fix the problem! We will be up and running shortly. Try refreshing the page or try again in a few minutes.

upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} (503 UC)

App Platform failed to forward this request to the application.

``` _This seems to be an issue with the [Wattsi Server](https://github.com/domenic/wattsi-server) service. PR Preview doesn't manage this service and so has no control over it. If you've identified an issue with it, you can [report the issue to the maintainers of Wattsi Server](https://github.com/domenic/wattsi-server/issues/new) directly. Please be courteous. Thank you!_ _If you don't have enough information above to solve the error by yourself or if the issue doesn't seem related to Wattsi Server, you can [file an issue with PR Preview](https://github.com/specinfra/pr-preview/issues/new?title=Unidentified%20Error&body=See%20whatwg/html%2313186.)._
